evals.prompt: Repair a TypeScript API client that casts parsed JSON directly to User and later crashes when a required nested property is absent.
evals.expected_output: The solution treats parsed data as untrusted, reuses or introduces a repository-compatible boundary parser, narrows before use, preserves actionable failure behavior, and adds runtime tests for invalid input.

evals.prompt: Refactor a TypeScript job state represented by one status string and six optional fields so consumers cannot construct invalid combinations.
evals.expected_output: The result models variants with their required data, updates construction and exhaustive consumption, preserves serialized compatibility where required, and avoids unrelated type-system complexity.

evals.prompt: A monorepo package passes an ad hoc tsc --noEmit command but fails its configured build with module-resolution errors. Diagnose and fix it.
evals.expected_output: The work resolves the effective package config, project references, runtime or bundler contract, and repository command before editing; it verifies with native build and type-check commands rather than weakening checks globally.

evals.prompt: Review a TypeScript library patch that replaces a generic return relationship with any to suppress a declaration-generation error.
evals.expected_output: The review preserves or redesigns the caller-visible input/output relationship, contains any unavoidable escape hatch, inspects emitted declarations, and verifies downstream inference or type fixtures.

evals.prompt: Add an AbortSignal-aware TypeScript API to a Node stream package and expose it through the package exports map.
evals.expected_output: The implementation composes TypeScript API and declaration guidance with Node stream and package guidance, preserves module consumers, validates runtime cancellation and cleanup, and checks emitted declarations.

evals.prompt: Refactor a browser TypeScript API that sends jobs to a Web Worker and accepts AbortSignal; cancellation currently leaves listeners and late replies behind.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the browser and worker runtime contract, message protocol, public types, and terminal-result ordering; make abort versus reply races deterministic, remove listeners and pending entries on every exit, define worker ownership, and test cancellation without introducing Node assumptions or loading JavaScript-only guidance.
